answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to a cryptographic stake burning mechanism. Each participant maintains a continuous heartbeat pulse of verifiable compute proofs. Isolated from any centralized hub, like a solitary island, rogue clusters attempting coordination face superlinear cost scaling: for n identities, burned stake scales as O(n^2). This economic friction freezes malicious expansion into a barren tundra of exponential capital depletion.
